class.name: IfcZShapeProfileDef
class.brief_description: IfcZShapeProfileDef defines a section profile that provides the defining parameters of a Z-shape section to be used by the swept area solid. Its parameters and orientation relative to the position coordinate system are according to the following illustration. The centre of the position coordinate system is in the profile's centre of the bounding box. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x2. IFC2x Edition 4 C
